clips.title: The story
paras: Important Heirlooms is a quest where an adventurer aids a nervous gnome named Thom, who was caught lurking in the Hall of Thanes when Dark Iron dwarves breached the vaults in subterranean mole machines. The task involves retrieving scattered dwarven relics under the dubious guise of historic preservation.

While exploring the subterranean vaults of the Hall of Thanes, an enterprising gnome named Thom was interrupted by the sudden arrival of Dark Iron dwarves tunneling upward in mole machines. Unable to secure the area himself, Thom recruits passing adventurers to brave the hostile dig site and retrieve valuable dwarven relics scattered across the chambers before the invaders seize or destroy them.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.
I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Look at you, as brave as you are enterprising! I'm a gnome of my word, and your reward is well earned!

Now, let me take a look at the haul--uh, I mean... The recovered heirlooms. I need to get started appraising--excuse me, 'cataloging' them so that they can be put back in their proper places as quickly as possible.
